budget_note: token_budget is a soft ceiling. Estimator: ascii_chars/4 + non_ascii_chars/2 (Arabic is token-dense). validate.py warns at 100%, fails at 130%.

bilingual_modes.mirror: Separate <name>.ar.md file. Arabic frontmatter carries source_sha of the EN body. Drift is machine-detectable.
bilingual_modes.inline: One file carrying both languages in the same row/block. Used where the file is written back frequently or is a lookup table — a mirror would be stale within minutes.
bilingual_modes.none: No Arabic surface. Reserved for machine-only artefacts (JSON indexes).

static_tree.role: Hop 0 router: commands, repo map, doc routing table, operating protocol.
Machine index of every doc: purpose, budget, language mode.
Cross-phase feature ledger. One row per feature, every phase that touched it.
Bilingual sync ledger written by validate.py.
Problem, personas, scope, and the anti-features list.
Functional and non-functional requirements with stable REQ ids.
Who uses this, what they can and cannot be assumed to know.
AR/EN term table. The authority for naming in code, UI copy, and client docs.
Layer boundaries, data ownership, contracts. Describes reality, not aspiration.
RFC 2119 machine-checkable constraints. Each load-bearing rule names its enforcer.
Entities, ownership per store, and mutation contracts.
ADR table: number, title, status, supersedes.
First ADR, seeded so the format is copied rather than invented.
Logo usage, voice, tone. Arabic and English copy rules stated separately.
Colour, spacing, radius, type. Must match the token file in code.
Component source of truth, required states, RTL and accessibility contracts.
What lives here, naming convention, export rules. Binaries only below this file.
Phase index: goal, status, exit criteria, features touched.
Deploy, rollback, on-call, and the recovery steps for each known failure.
Environment matrix and env-var NAMES. Never values.
Append-only: what shipped, when, which phase, rollback ref.

phase_tree.role: Phase goal, in/out of scope, exit criteria, feature list, risks.
The execution ledger. One write-target per phase. Dependency-ordered.

feature_tree.role: What this feature must do in this phase, traced to REQ ids.
How it will be built: vertical slices, touched layers, test plan, rollback.

markers.[/]: in progress — at most one per agent session
markers.[x]: done — typecheck, tests, and fitness functions green
markers.[!]: blocked — reason and whether human action is required MUST follow
markers.[~]: partial — what remains MUST be stated inline
